references.authors: J. A. Venables, G. D. T. Spiller, and M. Hanbücken
references.title: Nucleation and growth of thin films
references.note: Review of nucleation, growth modes, and thin-film formation. Used as a technical reference; no prose or figures are reproduced.

references.title: Atomic Layer Deposition: An Overview
references.note: Overview of ALD principles and process characteristics. Cited for background, not as a source of copied description or process recipes.

references.title: Surface chemistry of atomic layer deposition: A case study for the trimethylaluminum/water process
references.note: Surface-chemistry analysis for the TMA/water case. Chemistry-specific conclusions are not generalized to other precursor systems.

references.title: The microstructure of sputter-deposited coatings
references.container: Journal of Vacuum Science & Technology A
references.note: Reference on structure development in sputter-deposited coatings; regime maps are treated as qualitative heuristics with stated limits.

references.authors: M. J. G. V. M. Kleijn
references.title: On the modelling of transport phenomena in chemical vapour deposition and its use in reactor design and process optimization
references.note: CVD transport modeling reference. This book's resistance model is a deliberately reduced illustration, not a reactor design model.

references.authors: L. B. Freund and S. Suresh
references.title: Thin Film Materials: Stress, Defect Formation and Surface Evolution
references.note: Book-length treatment of thin-film stress, defects, and surface evolution. Used for technical grounding, not reproduced content.

references.authors: J. W. Matthews and A. E. Blakeslee
references.title: Defects in epitaxial multilayers: I. Misfit dislocations
references.note: Foundational misfit-dislocation analysis; critical-thickness predictions require system-specific assumptions.

references.authors: B. J. Janssen, M. M. Abdalla, F. van Keulen, B. R. Pujada, and G. Q. Zhang
references.title: Celebrating the 100th anniversary of the Stoney equation for film stress: Developments from its implementation in microelectronics to nowadays applications in MEMS research
references.note: Review of Stoney-equation applications and limitations. The lab uses only its isotropic, thin-film approximation.

references.authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
references.title: Thin-Film X-Ray Metrology for Microelectronics
references.note: Metrology report on thin-film X-ray measurements and traceability. The book links to the report but does not reproduce its figures or tables.

references.authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
references.title: Thin Film RGTMs
references.details: Project overview; created March 10, 2026; updated September 17, 2026; accessed October 15, 2026
references.note: NIST expands RGTMs as Research Grade Test Materials and describes thin-film materials for characterization inter-comparison. Accessed October 15, 2026; the page remains subject to change.
